newsitem.title: USA: ABC TV MAY NOT USE HIGH-DEFINITION TV - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: ABC TV MAY NOT USE HIGH-DEFINITION TV - WSJ.

text.p: Walt Disney Co's ABC television unit said it probably would not use high-definition television to broadcast several new channels during its initial move to digital television, the Wall Street Journal reported.

ABC network president Preston Padden said ABC instead is leaning toward using the digital spectrum assigned by the government earlier this year to broadcast the channels, according to the paper's electronic edition.
Padden made his comments at a digital-television conference in New York.
The decision is a sign that the future of high-definition television still remains far off, the paper said.
The paper also said that Baltimore-based Sinclair Broadcasting has already made a similar decision.
